socfpga_gic.c

GIC source implementation for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

gic_enable_gic
int32_t gic_enable_gic(
void
)

Saves the distributor and redistributor addresses. On Agilex 5 and Agilex 3 it records one redistributor. On other platforms it counts redistributors until GICR_TYPER says this is the last one. At EL3 it writes GICD_CTLR so affinity routing and interrupt groups 0 and 1 are on. At EL2 and EL1 it does not write GICD_CTLR.

Returns

INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR if the distributor address is NULL.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS otherwise.

gic_get_redist_id
int32_t gic_get_redist_id(
uint32_t 
affinity
)

Finds the redistributor whose GICR_TYPER affinity word equals affinity. On Agilex 5 and Agilex 3 the affinity argument is ignored and the function returns 0.

Parameters
affinity
uint32_t

Value compared with the affinity word in GICR_TYPER.

Returns

The matching redistributor index.  0 on Agilex 5 and Agilex 3.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR if the redistributor address is NULL.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS if no redistributor matches.

gic_wakeup_redist
int32_t gic_wakeup_redist(
uint32_t 
rd
)

Wakes redistributor rd. On Agilex 5 and Agilex 3 it writes 0 to GICR_PWRR and to GICR_WAKER, and waits a short time after each write.  On other platforms it clears the ProcessorSleep bit in GICR_WAKER and waits until the ChildrenAsleep bit is clear.

Parameters
rd
uint32_t

Redistributor index.

Returns

INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR if the redistributor address is NULL.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS otherwise.

gic_set_int_priority
int32_t gic_set_int_priority(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
rd,
uint8_t 
priority
)

Stores the priority of one interrupt. The value is shifted left by 4 before the write. Interrupt numbers 0 to 30 are written in the redistributor. Numbers 32 to 1019 are written in the distributor.  On Agilex 5 and Agilex 3, a redistributor priority that is not below the CPU priority mask is stored as one less than that mask. On other platforms a priority whose high 4 bits are all 1 is rejected.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

Interrupt number.

rd
uint32_t

Redistributor index. Used for interrupt numbers 0 to 30.

priority
uint8_t

Priority value.

Returns

INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS when the register is written.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_PRIORITY, INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR, INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_RDIST, INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_SPI, or INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_ID when a check fails.

gic_set_int_route
int32_t gic_set_int_route(
uint32_t 
id,
uint32_t 
mode,
uint32_t 
affinity
)

Builds a route word from mode and affinity. It writes that word to GICD_IROUTER only when id is from 64 to 1019. Other accepted ids still return success, and the register is left unchanged.

Parameters
id
uint32_t

Interrupt number.

mode
uint32_t

Routing mode. It is ORed into the route word.

affinity
uint32_t

Affinity value packed into the route word.

Returns

INTERRUPT_RETURN_ERROR if the distributor address is NULL.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_INVALID_SPI if id is outside 32 to 1019 and is not a valid extended SPI from 4096 to 5119.  INTERRUPT_RETURN_SUCCESS otherwise.
